text: Epic complete. All four one-shot estimand extensions are implemented and closed: signed cross-run Rayleigh (99df204), beta-free operator RSA (24b3cda), multi-contrast/full MANOVA spectra (f1fc13d), and coordinate-constrained nonnegative canonical MVPA (a9d2850; Gale 2d9c854). Each uses existing prepared geometry/operator/MVPA abstractions, carries explicit fold and nuisance semantics, has independent oracle evidence, and passes JVM/Scala.js gates. The final constrained slice also passes repository-wide compileAll testAll.
